title: Building a Financial Buffer Before the Next Shock

body.en: You've just received a small bonus. You know flood season is coming, and last year's flood cost your household real money in repairs and lost income. What's the smartest use of this money?

choices.label: Put it into a household emergency fund or savings group specifically for climate-related shocks
choices.consequence: Smart move. Financial resilience means having a buffer ready before the shock, not scrambling to find money during or after it — a dedicated fund is exactly that buffer.

choices.label: Spend it all now since money in hand is worth more than money saved
choices.consequence: Risky, given what you already know is coming. Last year's flood cost real money — spending the one buffer you have now leaves you exactly as exposed as before.

choices.label: Assume this year will be fine since last year is already over
choices.consequence: Not a safe assumption. Flood risk doesn't reset to zero just because last year has passed — the same conditions that caused it are often still there.
